question: Which permitted primary sources give a complete Nb3Sn (or NbTi/Nb3Sn) stellarator reactor design point — axis field, peak field on the coil, coil count, major and minor radius, winding-pack dimensions and current, conductor type, fusion power — usable as a sourced second coil-set anchor for the peak/axis field ratio and as an existence proof of a low-temperature-superconductor stellarator plant (HELIAS 5-B, HELIAS 4/5, HSR5/22, HSR4/18)?
where_to_look: Schauer, Egorov, Bykov 2013 Fusion Eng. Des. 88 1619 'HELIAS 5-B magnet system'
Warmer et al. 2016 Plasma Phys. Control. Fusion / IEEE 'From W7-X to a HELIAS fusion power plant' (open access)
Sagara / Wolf / Warmer HELIAS magnet and reactor papers on pure.mpg.de (author manuscripts)
